metadata.article_title: Application of this Part to the State of Punjab

article.title: Application of this Part to the State of Punjab
article.content: Omitted by the Constitution (Sixty-third Amendment) Act, 1989, s. 3 (w.e.f. 6-1-1990).
article.html:
359AApplication of this Part to the State of Punjab

Article 359A · Part XVIII

Omitted by the Constitution (Sixty-third Amendment) Act, 1989, s. 3 (w.e.f. 6-1-1990).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Fifty-ninth Amendment) Act, 1988, s. 3 (w.e.f. 30-3-1988) and ceased to operate on the expiry of a period of two years from the commencement of that Act, i.e. 30th day of March, 1988.
